title: Brian Burns: Giants feel different, but have to prove it on the field

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Brian Burns: Giants feel different, but have to prove it on the field
sources.description: The Giants' move to hire John Harbaugh as their head coach in January sparked hopes that the team will be able to return to being contender and that feeling has not flagged as the team nears the end of its offseason program.
